honesty: No Linear credentials in the test environment; live path unexercised against the real API. Dry-run, offline-payload, idempotency, retry, redaction, and guard behavior verified with stub transports.
idempotency: marker <!-- ap-sync:sha256=<content_sha256> -->; replay same content = NO-OP; changed content updates machine comment; human comments untouched
offline_mode: --offline-out writes exact GraphQL payloads (same constants/variables as live path); zero network in tests
ownership: never touches labels/status/assignee/priority; never auto-closes or auto-promotes; comment-only claim classes hard-asserted via _CommentOnlyGuard
secrets: API key from env var only, redacted from all errors; canary-key test asserts no leakage
